login.title: Sign in
login.signupHint: Students sign up here. Staff accounts come from the administrator.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.context: Sign up with your student record.
signup.emailHelper: Use your university email ending in @ejust.edu.eg.
signup.studentIdHelper: The ID on your university record.
signup.nationalIdHelper: The 14-digit number on your national ID card.

registered.title: Check your inbox
registered.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. The link expires after 60 minutes.
registered.resendHint: Nothing arrived? Submit the sign-up form again with the same email and student ID to get a new link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.context: We email you a link to set a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent a link to set a new password. The link expires after 60 minutes.
sent.nextStep: Open the link in the email to set a new password.

verify.readyBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
verify.heldTitle: We could not finish setting up your account
verify.heldBody: Contact the administration office to continue.
verify.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.invalidBody: Verification links last 60 minutes. Submit the sign-up form again with the same email to get a new link.
verify.unavailableTitle: The university data service is unavailable
verify.unavailableBody: The link stays valid for 60 minutes, so you can try again later.
verify.mismatchTitle: Your National ID does not match the university record
verify.mismatchBody: The National ID you entered does not match the record for this email. Submit the sign-up form again with the correct National ID.

errors.universityEmail: Use your university email ending in @ejust.edu.eg.
errors.credentials: These credentials do not match an account.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.studentIdTaken: This student ID is already registered.
